configurePresets.name: default
configurePresets.description: Shared STM32 setup: Ninja plus Arm GCC. Each child preset uses build/<presetName> with its own compiler cache.

configurePresets.name: Debug
configurePresets.description: Inherits the STM32 toolchain and Ninja settings; enables debug symbols and builds in build/Debug.

configurePresets.name: Release
configurePresets.description: Inherits the STM32 toolchain and Ninja settings; optimizes firmware size and builds in build/Release.

buildPresets.name: Debug
buildPresets.description: Compile the directory configured by the Debug configure preset.

buildPresets.name: Release
buildPresets.description: Compile the directory configured by the Release configure preset.
